title: Samsung's new foldables come with Gemini Notebook pre-installed
excerpt: The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Fold 8 and Flip 8 ship with Google's Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) pre-installed, an AI research tool that organizes web pages, videos and chats into one repository and turns them into slide decks, videos, flash cards and podcasts, with a chat function over your sources. Some features need paid Gemini; each device includes a six-month Google AI Pro trial. Distinct AI-tool angle from the rest of the Samsung Unpacked cluster.
